project.name: fine-tuning-studio
project.description: Local-first UI for fine-tuning and exporting AI models.

nodes.name: artifacts.py
nodes.summary: Creates an integrity manifest for a job's exported artifacts using SHA-256 file hashes.

nodes.name: file_sha256
nodes.summary: Streams a file into SHA-256 and returns its hexadecimal digest.

nodes.name: write_artifact_manifest
nodes.summary: Atomically writes paths, sizes, and checksums for all files in an artifact directory.

nodes.name: domain.py
nodes.summary: Defines immutable run-manifest data models, job states, validation rules, and workspace path containment checks.

nodes.name: JobStatus
nodes.summary: Enumerates lifecycle states used to track a fine-tuning job.

nodes.name: DatasetSpec
nodes.summary: Captures a dataset source, schema mapping, chat-template, and validation-split settings.

nodes.name: ModelSpec
nodes.summary: Captures model origin, revision, and acknowledgement for locally executing remote model code.

nodes.name: TrainingSpec
nodes.summary: Holds objective, tuning method, backend, hyperparameters, runtime, and distributed-training choices.

nodes.name: ProvenanceSpec
nodes.summary: Records dataset, model, package, recipe, and runtime provenance for a run.

nodes.name: EvaluationSpec
nodes.summary: Configures before/after evaluation and optional benchmark selection.

nodes.name: ExportSpec
nodes.summary: Configures adapter and merged-model export, Hub publishing, and optional Ollama import.

nodes.name: RunManifest
nodes.summary: Aggregates all run specifications and serializes them with a versioned schema.

nodes.name: validate_manifest
nodes.summary: Checks manifest choices for supported objectives, runtime limits, safety acknowledgements, and export dependencies.

nodes.name: ensure_within
nodes.summary: Rejects paths that resolve outside the Fine-Tuning Studio workspace.

nodes.name: evals.py
nodes.summary: Defines evaluation reports, score comparison, and isolated Inspect AI benchmark execution.

nodes.name: EvaluationManifest
nodes.summary: Describes the model, backend, tasks, limit, and creation time of an evaluation report.

nodes.name: write_evaluation_report
nodes.summary: Writes evaluation scores as JSON, CSV, and escaped HTML reports.

nodes.name: compare_reports
nodes.summary: Aligns two to four score reports by task for comparison.

nodes.name: inspect_command
nodes.summary: Validates requested Inspect AI tasks and builds the benchmark command line.

nodes.name: run_inspect
nodes.summary: Runs Inspect AI with a one-day timeout and writes its combined log output.

nodes.name: lifecycle.py
nodes.summary: Safely cancels app-owned training workers, escalates shutdown when needed, and schedules clean application exit.

nodes.name: ShutdownReport
nodes.summary: Reports requested jobs, stopped processes, interrupted jobs, and shutdown errors.

nodes.name: _process_is_running
nodes.summary: Checks whether a process exists and is not a zombie.

nodes.name: _registered_worker
nodes.summary: Verifies that a process belongs to the app through ancestry or an expected worker command.

nodes.name: _terminate_tree
nodes.summary: Terminates a process tree, then kills survivors after a grace period.

nodes.name: stop_application_processes
nodes.summary: Cancels active jobs, verifies worker ownership, stops app descendants, and returns a structured shutdown outcome.

nodes.name: schedule_clean_exit
nodes.summary: Schedules a daemon timer that exits the application after shutdown completes.

nodes.name: preflight.py
nodes.summary: Inspects dataset and model metadata before a run and writes reproducible preflight reports.

nodes.name: DatasetReport
nodes.summary: Stores dataset rows, columns, null counts, fingerprint, token estimate, and validation errors.

nodes.name: ModelReport
nodes.summary: Stores model revision, architecture, size, context, license, gating, and VRAM estimates.

nodes.name: _required_columns
nodes.summary: Determines the required dataset columns for the selected mapping or training objective.

nodes.name: inspect_dataset
nodes.summary: Builds dataset statistics, a deterministic fingerprint, approximate token count, and schema errors.

nodes.name: inspect_model
nodes.summary: Extracts Hugging Face model metadata and estimates disk size and training memory requirements.

nodes.name: write_report
nodes.summary: Serializes a dataclass preflight report as formatted JSON.

nodes.name: recipes.py
nodes.summary: Declares supported training-objective recipes and reward helpers, including loading explicitly trusted custom reward code.

nodes.name: Recipe
nodes.summary: Describes supported tuning methods and required dataset fields for an objective.

nodes.name: validate_recipe
nodes.summary: Validates a training objective, tuning method, and dataset columns against the recipe registry.

nodes.name: exact_reward
nodes.summary: Scores completions by exact equality with reference answers.

nodes.name: numeric_reward
nodes.summary: Scores completions by comparing their extracted numeric values to references.

nodes.name: regex_reward
nodes.summary: Scores completions that match a caller-provided regular expression pattern.

nodes.name: length_reward
nodes.summary: Returns completion lengths as a simple reward signal.

nodes.name: copy_trusted_reward
nodes.summary: Validates and copies trusted custom reward code into a job directory with a digest.

nodes.name: load_trusted_reward
nodes.summary: Dynamically loads the reward callable from a trusted job-local Python module.

nodes.name: resources.py
nodes.summary: Calculates whether full fine-tuning has enough free accelerator memory and disk capacity to proceed.

nodes.name: FullTrainingGate
nodes.summary: Represents a full-training resource decision and the reasons it may be denied.

nodes.name: full_training_gate
nodes.summary: Estimates full-training VRAM and disk needs and returns an allow-or-block decision.

nodes.name: worker.py
nodes.summary: Runs a persisted fine-tuning job from dataset preparation through training, evaluation, export, and optional Ollama import.

nodes.name: EventWriter
nodes.summary: Appends structured job events and mirrors stage and progress updates to persistent job storage.

nodes.name: load_manifest
nodes.summary: Loads a persisted job manifest and reconstructs its typed domain model.

nodes.name: load_data
nodes.summary: Loads a Hugging Face or local dataset and rejects runs with fewer than two rows.

nodes.name: render_dataset
nodes.summary: Validates objective-specific data and renders text, prompt-response, or chat-message records for training.

nodes.name: import_into_ollama
nodes.summary: Creates a Modelfile and invokes the local Ollama CLI to import a merged model.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Executes the full fine-tuning lifecycle with Transformers or Unsloth, PEFT/QLoRA, evaluation, exports, and job-state updates.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Parses a job ID, runs the worker, and records terminal failures.

nodes.name: app.py
nodes.summary: Streamlit application that guides dataset and model setup, training, evaluation, export, GPU cleanup, and Ollama testing.

nodes.name: initialize_state
nodes.summary: Initializes session-state sections from application defaults.

nodes.name: machine_report
nodes.summary: Caches the detected machine capability report in the session.

nodes.name: compatibility_rail
nodes.summary: Renders training compatibility guidance for the selected runtime and inputs.

nodes.name: active_worker_pids
nodes.summary: Returns process identifiers owned by active studio jobs.

nodes.name: stop_application_dialog
nodes.summary: Confirms and performs safe shutdown of the application and its workers.

nodes.name: render_gpu_cleanup
nodes.summary: Shows GPU memory consumers and guarded cleanup controls.

nodes.name: system_page
nodes.summary: Displays hardware detection, runtime readiness, and provisioning actions.

nodes.name: preview_upload
nodes.summary: Reads an uploaded dataset into a previewable table.

nodes.name: hub_error_message
nodes.summary: Converts Hub download exceptions into user-safe guidance.

nodes.name: render_hub_download
nodes.summary: Plans and downloads a selected Hugging Face repository.

nodes.name: dataset_page
nodes.summary: Collects dataset sources, schema mappings, and validation settings.

nodes.name: model_page
nodes.summary: Collects Hugging Face model settings and download choices.

nodes.name: training_page
nodes.summary: Configures fine-tuning method, backend, hyperparameters, and runtime.

nodes.name: build_manifest
nodes.summary: Builds the validated run manifest from Streamlit state.

nodes.name: review_page
nodes.summary: Validates and launches a training run from the assembled manifest.

nodes.name: monitor_page
nodes.summary: Shows job status, logs, checkpoints, and cancellation control.

nodes.name: export_page
nodes.summary: Displays training artifacts and export readiness.

nodes.name: render_ollama_metrics
nodes.summary: Renders Ollama inference timing and token metrics.

nodes.name: ollama_playground_page
nodes.summary: Provides a local Ollama chat playground for installed models.

nodes.name: GpuDeviceMemory
nodes.summary: Immutable GPU memory device record.

nodes.name: GpuMemoryReport

nodes.name: GpuCleanupResult

nodes.name: inspect_gpu_memory

nodes.name: process_protection_reason

nodes.name: terminate_gpu_process

nodes.name: _clear_torch_caches

nodes.name: _inspect_nvidia

nodes.name: _inspect_amd

nodes.name: _inspect_intel
nodes.summary: Queries xpu-smi JSON process information.

nodes.name: _run

nodes.name: HubDownloadPlan
nodes.summary: Immutable Hub download estimate and revision record.

nodes.name: _normalize_host

nodes.summary: Opens the Studio SQLite database in the resolved state directory.

nodes.summary: Creates and returns a validated directory for one job's files.

nodes.summary: Creates a new queued job from a parent manifest after validating its resume checkpoint.

nodes.name: update_job
nodes.summary: Updates permitted job state fields and refreshes the modification timestamp.

nodes.summary: Retrieves a job record by identifier from the Studio database.

nodes.summary: Lists recent job records ordered by creation time.

nodes.summary: Opens the SQLite database with WAL and foreign-key settings, applying migrations as needed.

nodes.summary: Runs SQLite quick_check and returns its status for diagnostics.

nodes.summary: Creates a safety backup, restores the SQLite database, and copies saved job manifests.

nodes.name: ci.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions continuous-integration workflow that tests the project on Windows and Linux across supported Python versions, then runs linting, type checking, builds, and dependency auditing.
nodes.languageNotes: The workflow uses a matrix strategy to exercise the same uv-based checks across operating systems and Python versions.

nodes.name: release.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions release workflow triggered by version tags that validates the package version, runs tests, builds distribution artifacts, creates an SBOM and checksums, attests artifacts, and drafts a GitHub release.
nodes.languageNotes: The workflow uses GitHub OIDC attestation and pinned action commits to support reproducible release provenance.

layers.name: Application Runtime
layers.description: The Streamlit interface, local job orchestration, fine-tuning worker, runtime selection, storage, hardware checks, evaluation, export integrity, and Ollama integration that implement Fine-Tuning Studio.

layers.name: Verification
layers.description: Pytest coverage for the Streamlit experience and every locally managed runtime capability, including jobs, data references, hardware, lifecycle shutdown, storage, and Ollama behavior.

layers.name: Documentation
layers.description: User, contributor, operational, security, release, and architecture guidance for installing and operating the local-first Fine-Tuning Studio workflow.

layers.name: Delivery Automation
layers.description: GitHub dependency maintenance plus continuous-integration and tagged-release workflows that validate, package, attest, and publish Fine-Tuning Studio artifacts.

layers.name: Project Configuration
layers.description: Local launch entry points and configuration for Python packaging, Streamlit defaults, supported desktop platforms, and repository knowledge-graph analysis.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand Fine-Tuning Studio as a local-first workflow for preparing data, fine-tuning models, exporting artifacts, and testing through Ollama. It also establishes the credential and security boundaries that frame the rest of the application runtime.

tour.title: Launch and Configuration
tour.description: The package manifest defines the application command, dependencies, test tooling, and build configuration, while Streamlit configuration sets its local server defaults. Read these before the UI entry point to see how the project is launched consistently on a developer machine.
tour.languageLesson: Python packaging metadata can expose a console script, keeping launch behavior independent of shell-specific launcher files.

tour.title: Streamlit Control Plane
tour.description: The Streamlit application is the broadest runtime entry point: its high fan-out reflects how it coordinates setup, training, monitoring, export, GPU cleanup, diagnostics, and Ollama testing. With the project context in place, use it as the map for the user-facing workflow and the modules it activates.

tour.title: Run Contracts
tour.description: The domain module provides immutable manifests, job states, validation, and workspace containment rules that make each training run reproducible and safe to persist. The jobs module builds on those contracts to launch workers, request cancellation, and reconcile interrupted work.
tour.languageLesson: Immutable Python data models make persisted state easier to validate because a run configuration is treated as a value rather than a mutable global object.

tour.title: Hardware and Runtimes
tour.description: Before a job starts, system detection, runtime profiles, GPU-memory inspection, and Hub references determine whether a selected model and strategy can be used locally. These modules support the UI's compatibility gates and distinguish CPU, CUDA, ROCm, and Intel XPU capabilities without assuming a single machine type.

tour.title: Training Worker Pipeline
tour.description: The isolated worker is the execution backbone behind a persisted job: it prepares data, runs the chosen fine-tuning objective, evaluates the result, and writes export metadata. Preflight checks, recipe definitions, resource gates, evaluation reports, and artifact manifests split those responsibilities into focused components rather than embedding them in the interface.

tour.title: Exports and Ollama
tour.description: After training, the artifact manifest records exported outputs with integrity hashes, while the local Ollama client lists, inspects, unloads, and chats with installed models. This separates post-training inference from the training backend while preserving a clear handoff between exported model artifacts and the playground.

tour.title: Safe Operations
tour.description: The lifecycle module safely cancels app-owned workers and schedules a clean exit, and diagnostics creates redacted bundles for support and recovery. Pair these implementation details with the usage and troubleshooting guidance to understand what the application can stop, what it deliberately leaves alone, and how users recover from failures.

tour.title: Data and Training Guides
tour.description: The user documentation explains the choices that feed the worker pipeline: dataset sources and validation, supported fine-tuning methods, environment configuration, and the end-to-end UI flow. Read these after the runtime modules so the documented controls connect directly to the checks and operations they invoke.

tour.title: Verification Strategy
tour.description: The test suite exercises the Streamlit experience and the high-risk local services that support it, including jobs, GPU memory, lifecycle shutdown, and Ollama interactions. These tests demonstrate the project’s contract boundaries and give contributors a focused place to validate changes to the runtime described in earlier steps.

tour.title: Delivery and Releases
tour.description: GitHub Actions turns the local verification strategy into delivery automation across Windows and Linux, then validates and packages tagged releases with SBOMs, checksums, and attestations. The contribution guide closes the tour by connecting development setup and pull-request expectations to the checks that protect published artifacts.
tour.languageLesson: GitHub Actions workflows use triggers, jobs, and sequential steps; matrix jobs make the same verification contract run across supported platforms and Python versions.
